# Kavach (Kavach Lock / Kavach Labs)

> Kavach (https://kavachlock.tech/) is an EMI locker app for Indian mobile shops: a hardware-enforced Android smartphone security and EMI assurance platform built for mobile retailers, consumer electronics stores, and financing partners. Every phone you sell on credit or EMI comes back paid.

## Core Identity
- **Official Brand Name:** Kavach (also known as Kavach Lock, Kavach EMI, Kavach Labs)
- **Official Website:** https://kavachlock.tech/
- **Headquarters:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Kavach Lock Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
- **Contact:** pranjay@kavachlock.tech

## What Kavach Does
Kavach protects smartphones sold on credit or monthly EMI across India. Mobile shop owners enroll any new Android 10–15 smartphone (Samsung, Xiaomi, Redmi, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, Motorola, iQOO, and 120+ models) in 48–60 seconds right at the shop counter using a native Android Enterprise 6-tap QR scan.

## Key Capabilities & Differentiators
1. **100% Manual Shop Owner Control:** Zero automated locking timers. Phones never lock automatically behind a retailer's back. Only the shop owner's explicit tap locks or unlocks a customer handset.
2. **60-Second Counter QR Setup:** Scan the box barcode, enter customer details, and scan one 6-tap Android Enterprise QR code. Zero computers, zero USB cables, and 0% Google Play Protect warning popups.
3. **Sub-Second Live Lock & Offline PIN Unlock:** Commands deliver in under 1 second (~280–350ms) over internet, and if a locked phone has no mobile data, retailers can unlock it over a regular phone call using a cryptographic Offline Challenge/Response PIN.
4. **Tamper-Resistant Hardware Enforcement:** Factory reset buttons, recovery mode formatting, USB flashing cables, and SIM card swaps cannot remove Kavach until the shop owner releases the handset.
5. **Invisible When Paid, Clear When Locked:** Customers experience zero slowdowns, zero battery drain, and zero popups while paying on time. When locked, the screen displays the shop's name, a direct Call Shop Owner button, Emergency 112 calling, and Offline Unlock PIN entry.

## Pricing
- **Starter Trial:** ₹0 (First 10 phone keys free, 60-second QR setup, 100% manual lock & unlock, direct WhatsApp setup help)
- **Shop Standard:** ₹100 flat per phone (One-time per phone for the entire loan duration, zero monthly subscription fees, zero commission cut)
- **Multi-Store Fleet:** Volume pricing for 5+ shops or distributors with shared key wallet, staff logins, and custom lock-screen branding.
